closed_eye.method: Cut only eye_aperture_polygon_px from the Head to make an actual open-eye shadow aperture; leave the upper eyeliner and nose bridge intact. Add a thin solid eyelid part using eyelid_polygon_px on a Head-child Eyelid bone. Map only the closed-eye skin patch from source_bounds_px to target_bounds_px; Night shows the physical eyelid, Day hides it. Do not use a rectangular face plane.

notes: All pixel coordinates use the actual 2048 x 1365 source image, origin at top left; they are not thumbnail coordinates.

Main source is exclusively the far-left Day puppet. The model is an articulated leather silhouette with real cutout holes and 0.65 cm edge walls; no full rectangular image card belongs in the character mesh.
Head selection deliberately contains the complete loose red/black hair. Preserve the intact human face silhouette, nose, lips and forehead; do not treat pale skin as background.

Gold eyelet centers identify pivots. Small overlapping leather tabs at each split must remain so rigid rotations do not expose background slits. The source polygons slightly overlap at the joint areas.
BodyUpper and BodyMiddle share the left bend pivot. BodyLower continues around the right bend. Tail attaches at the bottom gold eyelet; preserve the upward tail barb near x351,y777.
Layer offsets form a leather stack: Head 1.4 cm, Neck 0.7 cm, BodyUpper/BodyLower 0 cm, BodyMiddle -0.7 cm, Tail 0.7 cm. Use axis +X as the front and rotate around the leather normal.

Rest preserves the source S curve. Day, Night and Reach use restrained rigid part angles; Night additionally requires the Closed Head variant or an explicit eyelid geometry cover. Merely rotating the open-eye Head is not a completed closed-eye state.

The closed-eye source patch is from the right large Night puppet and excludes eyebrows, nose and mouth. Its skin colors and eye angle differ slightly from the left puppet; blend its boundary inside the face texture and verify the shadow also closes the eye aperture.
Do not extract the center enlarged face diagrams, scale bars, labels, right-hand rods, lower swatches or reference drawings as character parts.
For moving shadow acceptance, verify Rest/Reach joints with the Movable stage light and compare the Day and Night eye silhouettes; generated topology alone is not artistic or gameplay acceptance.

Every part now has exclude_polygons_px for the source dimension annotations: left vertical, left two shoulder tick lines, tail-height dashed line, inner-curve dashed line, right lower vertical and lower width baseline. Apply these in original source-pixel coordinates before generating connected components or dilating masks. Exclusions intentionally stop outside the dragon contour.

closed_eye now supplies an inner-eye aperture and a slightly larger eyelid polygon, measured at 12x zoom of original pixels. Preserve upper eyelid eyeliner and nose bridge; the aperture includes iris/white interior only. The optional 8th Eyelid bone is internal model presentation and introduces no gameplay input.

Final right-side annotation correction: source lower width-extension line has its dark center at x623-624, not x625. The right lower exclusion starts outside the leather edge at [624,825], steps to x622 at y832 then x620 below y844; the true colored edge is retained at x620/y833 and x617/y843. This removes the vertical splinter visible in Run1 Rest/Oblique without changing the body outline or eyelid.

provenance.method: Contour-modeled extruded leather pieces from existing project concept; real holes, rigid articulation, cleaned artwork UV atlas; no purchased mesh or new image generation.
provenance.texture_note: Stylized painted artwork, not a scanned physical albedo. Existing design-sheet markings are excluded.
